name: fitinn-app
description: Fit-Inn Trier – native App-Hülle (Capacitor) um das Mitgliederportal (Live-URL-Wrapper + Push + Apple/Google-Login + Biometrie)

scripts.setup: npm install && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && npx cap sync && node patch-native.js
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && node patch-native.js && cap open ios
scripts.android: cap sync android && node patch-native.js && cap open android
